comment: a footer stuck above the bottom of the scrollport before it is reached and in flow afterwards; a box stuck below the top by its inset; in a horizontal scroller, boxes stuck by left and right. Rendered without MSAA ("samples": 1), at the default tolerances: with 4x MSAA, Mesa's llvmpipe and lavapipe (the test image's GL and Vulkan drivers, Mesa 23.2.1) let half the samples of the row above and the column left of a scissor rectangle through, so content scrolled past a clip edge would show a half-covered 1 px line there (MsaaScissor.FourSamples reproduces it with raw sokol calls; the scissor reaches glScissor/vkCmdSetScissor as exact integers, the max edges are exact)
